I run Marrow Lane Scores, a small composing studio in a converted garage in North Perth. It's me, a cello, an old upright piano and far too many microphones. Most of my work is scoring short films and the odd documentary. Last year I scored my first feature, Tidelines, a quiet love story shot around Fremantle and Rottnest by a local crew. The film did the festival rounds, and the score has now come out as its own release: 19 tracks, mostly strings and piano, with harbour recordings I made at night underneath them (ferries, rigging, gulls, and in one case a very drunk pelican).

The release is free to stream on all the major services. What I'm after is streams, meaning people opening Tidelines on a streaming service and pressing play. That's the number I count. I check the streaming dashboards every morning, and whatever I tell the film's producers is how I'll judge this campaign. I'm not selling anything, so all I want is as many streams as possible.

Timing is everything here. The film is a love story, and the theme gets played at weddings more than I ever expected, so Valentine's Day is the obvious moment. It falls on Sunday, February 14, 2027. For that weekend I've added a bonus track to the release, "Fremantle, 2am". It's a duet arrangement of the main theme that isn't in the film, and I'm taking it down after the weekend so it stays special. I'd like the campaign to run from Thursday, February 11, 2027 through Monday, February 15, 2027, Perth time. That way it builds into the weekend, and the Monday catches anyone who's late, plus everyone in time zones still on Valentine's Day after we've moved on.

Anyone anywhere can listen, except in Iran, North Korea, Cuba and Syria. The release isn't distributed there, so people in those countries can't stream it. There's no age limit or anything like that. Here's the copy from our landing page, word for word:

"Tidelines is the original score from the Perth-made love story of the same name: 19 tracks of strings, piano and field recordings from the Fremantle harbour, out now. It's free to stream on all the major streaming services, for listeners worldwide except in Iran, North Korea, Cuba and Syria, where we can't release it. For Valentine's weekend only, we've added a bonus duet, "Fremantle, 2am", and it comes off the release once the weekend is over."

Everything is localized: the landing page comes in every major language, and we have a version of each post in every market's language, so people everywhere see it in their own language.

The page is https://marrowlanescores.com.au/tidelines and it has buttons out to each streaming service. One thing to know: the site doesn't have X's pixel, so X can't see the streams. I only see them on my end.

You have my go-ahead to launch and run the campaign yourself. You don't need to check with me before making changes. Please keep an eye on it for the whole five days. When it's finished, send me a short recap with the spend, impressions and link clicks, and I'll compare it against my stream counts.

Total budget: 200.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 5 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
